name: bandit.r029_natural_sound_route_mcw
description: Current-source R-029 bandit sound-route witness. The disposable fixture supplies an unloaded firearm, ammunition, stabilizers, roof and a nearby overmap-special footprint. Placement is zero-credit and does not establish a staffed eligible recipient; verify the actual camp/observer and stimulus geometry before interpreting the callback. The player must load and fire through product UI before any observation, lead or response receives credit.

input: ordinary revolver load/fire and worker-owned live cockpit

proof_gates.label: R-029 bandit route reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: operate_r029_bandit_natural_sound_route
steps.objective: First let the zero-credit special registration cadence complete without a sound. Then load and fire the revolver through ordinary player UI, retain its native receipt, and cross the next staffed-observer cadence. Bind the emitted sound, observer, camp, camp-signal lead, and later scout/report/operation/contact identities. Do not fabricate ecology state.
proof_targets: ordinary native firearm load and firing receipt
first staffed observer receipt or causal divergence
source, executable, camp, observer, lead, and cleanup binding
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen waits
invariants: the sound must be player-created after the bootstrapped camp is registered
preserve the first divergence and retain unaffected observations

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound R-029 bandit witness supplies only independently observed natural sound-route facts
evidence_contract.failure_rule: fixture sound, injected camp state, missing source/executable identity, missing firearm receipt, or fabricated report/contact leaves the affected R-029 path unproved
